views.name: posts_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  PostTypeId,
  AcceptedAnswerId,
  CreaionDate,
  Score,
  ViewCount,
  Body,
  OwnerUserId,
  LasActivityDate,
  Title,
  Tags,
  AnswerCount,
  CommentCount,
  FavoriteCount,
  LastEditorUserId,
  LastEditDate,
  CommunityOwnedDate,
  ParentId,
  ClosedDate,
  OwnerDisplayName,
  LastEditorDisplayName
FROM posts
WHERE 1=1
views.description: Normalized projection of the posts table that preserves original identifiers and canonicalizes obvious datetime typos. Use this as the cleaned posts relation for downstream joins and aggregations. | Use for: Post-level aggregates (views, score, answer/comment counts); Join posts to users, comments, votes, tags; Filter posts by type, date ranges, tags text

views.name: users_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  Reputation,
  CreationDate,
  DisplayName,
  LastAccessDate,
  WebsiteUrl,
  Location,
  AboutMe,
  Views,
  UpVotes,
  DownVotes,
  AccountId,
  Age,
  ProfileImageUrl
FROM users
WHERE 1=1
views.description: Passengers projection of the users table preserving user identifiers and core attributes/measures for joins and reporting. | Use for: User-level metrics and cohorts; Join users to posts, badges, comments, votes

views.name: comments_by_post
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  PostId,
  COUNT(*) AS comment_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Score IS NOT NULL THEN Score ELSE 0 END) AS comment_score_sum,
  AVG(CASE WHEN Score IS NOT NULL THEN Score ELSE NULL END) AS comment_score_avg,
  MAX(CreationDate) AS last_comment_date
FROM comments
GROUP BY PostId
views.description: Aggregated comment measures per PostId: total comments, average and sum of comment Score, and most recent comment CreationDate. Useful when combining comment activity with posts without multiplying rows. | Use for: Compare posts by comment activity; Join comment aggregates to posts for ranking or filtering

views.name: votes_by_post
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  PostId,
  VoteTypeId,
  COUNT(*) AS votes_of_type
FROM votes
GROUP BY PostId, VoteTypeId
views.description: Aggregated vote counts by PostId and VoteTypeId plus total votes per post. Useful for reconstructing vote distributions without multiplying post rows. | Use for: Compute counts of upvotes/downvotes/accepts/bounties by type; Pivot vote types per post or join to posts for scoring adjustments

views.name: badges_by_user
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  UserId,
  COUNT(*) AS badge_count,
  MAX(Date) AS last_badge_date
FROM badges
GROUP BY UserId
views.description: Badge counts per user and the date of their most recent badge. Useful for summarizing user recognition without returning every badge row. | Use for: Compare users by number of badges; Filter active badge recipients within date ranges

views.name: post_links_pairs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  CreationDate,
  PostId,
  RelatedPostId,
  LinkTypeId
FROM postLinks
WHERE 1=1
views.description: Denormalized view of post links preserving directionality and both post ids plus link metadata. Use when exploring relationships between posts or building graph edges. | Use for: Find linked questions/answers; Build graph walks between posts

views.name: posts_with_authors
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.Id,
  p.PostTypeId,
  p.AcceptedAnswerId,
  p.CreaionDate,
  p.Score,
  p.ViewCount,
  p.Body,
  p.OwnerUserId,
  u.DisplayName AS DisplayName,
  u.Reputation AS Reputation,
  p.LasActivityDate,
  p.Title,
  p.Tags,
  p.AnswerCount,
  p.CommentCount,
  p.FavoriteCount,
  p.ParentId
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u
  ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
views.description: Denormalized one-row-per-post combining posts and their owner user information. Use for reporting where you need both post metrics and author attributes. | Use for: List posts with author name and reputation; Filter posts by author attributes (location, reputation) after extending this CTE

views.name: latest_posthistory_per_post
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ph.Id,
  ph.PostId,
  ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
  ph.RevisionGUID,
  ph.CreationDate,
  ph.UserId,
  ph.Text,
  ph.Comment,
  ph.UserDisplayName
FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PostId ORDER BY CreationDate DESC, Id DESC) AS rn
  FROM postHistory
) ph
WHERE ph.rn = 1
views.description: Latest postHistory row per PostId by CreationDate. Useful to attach the most recent revision/commentary to posts without multiplying rows. | Use for: Attach most recent revision/comment to a post; Identify posts with recent edits and the editing user

views.name: top_level_questions
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  PostTypeId,
  AcceptedAnswerId,
  CreaionDate,
  Score,
  ViewCount,
  Body,
  OwnerUserId,
  LasActivityDate,
  Title,
  Tags,
  AnswerCount,
  CommentCount,
  FavoriteCount,
  ParentId
FROM posts
WHERE ParentId IS NULL
views.description: Subset of posts that are top-level questions (posts with no ParentId). Use as a question cohort; does not filter by any specific tag or date so it's broadly reusable. | Use for: Analyze questions (exclude answers/comments); Filter or rank by question-level metrics
